scope: Source audit; parent performs browser QA

fixed.fix: Added shared session-only motion state; system reduced motion takes precedence.
Added footer pause/resume, GSAP context cleanup, pointer reset and transient-confetti cleanup.
Disabled smooth scroll with !important and all decorative CSS transforms/transitions while paused.
Mobile menu now closes when keyboard focus leaves the header; header Contacts/brand anchors also close it.
Flavor interaction now animates inner use geometry, preserving the separate scroll animation.
Pointer geometry separated from scroll targets in occasion, FAQ and contact scenes.
Fixed dark-green focus outlines on burgundy surfaces (previous contrast 1.08:1); lime gives 6.62:1.
Fixed inherited dark selection color on burgundy form buttons; transparent background retained.
Changed candy choice grid to two columns on narrow phones; removed mid-word breaking.
Name requires at least two Unicode letters; phone validates allowed punctuation and 11 Russian digits, rejecting letters.
Added semantic name/phone autofill and polite inline validation announcements.
Added accessible group for game contents; empty slots get role=img with a meaningful label.
Refresh scroll geometry after font loading, window load and FAQ expansion.
Restore effective animation preference after Back/Forward cache return.
Submit starts disabled until preventDefault handler installation; noscript phone fallback prevents default GET submission without JavaScript.
